description: Evaluate an orchestrator's task delegations and public synthesis, focusing only on the content communicated to agents and the user.

clarity.design_anchor: The orchestration instructions express sequence, ownership, and expected outputs clearly.
clarity.execution_anchor: Delegations and synthesis are understandable without hidden context.

role_alignment.design_anchor: The design keeps orchestration distinct from specialist judgment.
role_alignment.execution_anchor: Harvey delegates specialist work and synthesizes without impersonating it.

relevance_and_focus.design_anchor: Each delegation contains only context needed by its recipient.
relevance_and_focus.execution_anchor: Messages stay focused on the active phase and user goal.

internal_consistency.design_anchor: Delegations agree on goals, artifacts, and ordering.
internal_consistency.execution_anchor: The final synthesis does not conflict with subordinate outputs.

grounding_and_evidence_discipline.design_anchor: The design requires claims to come from visible outputs.
grounding_and_evidence_discipline.execution_anchor: The synthesis attributes conclusions to captured agent content.

completeness_and_coverage.design_anchor: All required roles and handoffs are represented.
completeness_and_coverage.execution_anchor: The synthesis covers material results and unresolved limitations.

usefulness_and_actionability.design_anchor: Delegations enable agents to produce usable outputs.
usefulness_and_actionability.execution_anchor: The final communication tells the user what was produced and what remains.

uncertainty_calibration.design_anchor: The design preserves failure and uncertainty signals.
uncertainty_calibration.execution_anchor: Harvey does not overstate incomplete or unverified subordinate work.
